prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Opens mid-action: a thick steak flipped in a cast-iron pan, flames licking up the side, violent sizzle. The camera follows to an egg cracked one-handed straight into the hot pan beside the steak, the white setting instantly around a whole intact yolk, edges crisping golden. Then rice steaming as a scoop lifts. Money shot: the sliced steak, deep pink center revealed cut by cut, laid over rice with the whole fried egg sliding on top, intact yolk catching warm backlight. Final beat: the loaded plate landing on the table with weight, fork driving in. Warm 3200K light, deep shadows, macro on the meat fibers, film grain. Dominant sound: the flame sear, then the knife through crust. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music. The egg is never beaten or whisked; the yolk stays whole from pan to plate.
caption:
O treino é meia hora. A comida é o resto do resultado.

O Massa & Força é a semana montada pra quem treina: proteína em toda refeição, carboidrato na medida, zero invenção.
